text:
Jonah Patel: hi team 1 1 starting Monday, couple of quick onboarding questions: 1) my spouse lives in France and wed like to add them to dental/vision. theyre on a french bank account and NHS-equivalent government coverageis that ok? 2) the benefits carrier usually mails a physical ID card 1 but they only ship domestically (US). can redwood arrange international courier or reimburse shipping so I can get a hard card for local providers? 3) my signing bonus is split into two payments (50% first paycheck, 50% after 90d). will the second payment be taxed differently? 4) paid 6 weeks of storage in EUR during relocation; vendor only provided a PayPal transaction and a WhatsApp screenshot invoice. will that be accepted for reimbursement and do you need the VAT line separated? 5) my start date falls on a company holiday 1 will that affect benefits effective date or PTO accrual?

Rima (People Ops): welcome Jonah! :wave: Short answers: (1) dependents living abroad can be covered for most plans but we need proof of relationship (marriage cert or civil partnership) and a proof of address for the dependent. Some carriers restrict out-of-country dependent coverage for certain services 1 we will check plan terms and confirm. Please upload docs to the dependent enrollment page.

Rima (People Ops): (2) physical card shipping: carriers typically issue a digital ID (mobile card/PDF) for international addresses. If you need a physical card we can approve reimbursement for a courier if you arrange it yourself (submit courier receipt). Alternatively we can request an expedited proof-of-coverage letter from the carrier for immediate clinic use 1 that usually works internationally.

Rima (People Ops): (3) signing bonus: payroll classifies both parts according to the payment type. The second tranche is not automatically taxed differently, but supplemental/one-off payments may be subject to different withholding (depending on jurisdiction). Payroll will confirm tax withholding method for the second payment.

Ellen (Payroll): adding payroll notes: Jonah, for the spouse living in France we may need additional tax documentation depending on whether any benefit is treated as a taxable imputed income in your home payroll jurisdiction. For US payroll, wed check W-9 vs W-8BEN status and residency. DM me your employment type (US vs UK contract) and Ill pre-check.

Ellen (Payroll): (storage reimbursement) PayPal TXN + WhatsApp screenshot: we can accept screenshots if they clearly show vendor name/date/amount and you provide a matching proof-of-payment (PayPal transaction confirmation or bank statement). VAT: we reimburse the total you paid (gross). For accounting we separate the tax line if present. Please attach everything to the expense entry and mark as "relocation-storage" so we expedite.

BenefitsBot: :page_facing_up: Newhire checklist updated: dependent docs upload link, digital ID request form, relocation expense guidance. See https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/x/RelocBenefits for details.

Jonah Patel: thanks 1 quick follow-ups: (a) vendor only gave a PayPal TXN and the WhatsApp screenshotno formal invoice header. is the PayPal transaction ID enough if I also include the bank statement showing the debit? (b) for the proof-of-coverage letter, how fast can that be issued? I have a dentist appointment in Paris on Thursday.

Rima (People Ops): (a) yes the PayPal TXN ID + bank statement showing the outbound payment is usually sufficient for AP to process, especially for relocation storage. Make sure the screenshot shows the vendor name and service dates. (b) proof-of-coverage letter: we can request an expedited carrier letter; typical turnaround is 242 hours once we submit the request. If you need it faster DM me and Ill escalate.

Ellen (Payroll): Jonah 1 please DM me the last 4 of the bank used for the PayPal payment and the PayPal TXN ID so I can match it. Timeline: once the expense is approved AP processes reimbursements in 7 business days; courier reimbursements (customs paperwork) may take longer due to cross-border clearance but we can push for AP wire if needed.

Jonah Patel: DM sent with TXN and last4. Also uploaded PayPal confirmation + WhatsApp screenshot to expense portal and tagged relocation-storage. One more: if carrier only gives a digital card, can I print a PDF and is that accepted by clinics in Paris?

Rima (People Ops): printing the carriers PDF/mobile ID normally works for clinics but some providers prefer a carrier-issued letter. Well request the proof-of-coverage letter in parallel; please try the PDF print at the clinic and let us know if they reject it and well escalate.

Ellen (Payroll): final note: start-date holiday 1 no change to benefits effective date (it will be your official start date). PTO accrual is prorated from start date; a company-observed holiday inside your first accrual period does not reduce prorated entitlement. If any payroll holds occur (I-9 / ID verification) we will mark pay/deductions as pending and notify you.

Jonah Patel: perfect, thanks everyone 1 appreciate the speedy help!
